title: "`r params$title`"
output:
  html_document:
     toc: true
     toc_float: true
     toc_depth: 2
date: "`r format(Sys.time(), '%B %d, %Y')`"
params:
  title: "IGS figures"
  blocks: null
  fig_dir: ""
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Rendered by render_igs_figures() in an environment whose parent is the monolixPipelineR
# namespace. Each block is a section (e.g. the wide IGS); each figure is drawn to a PNG and
# shown at its own size. Doesn't need Monolix.
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

```{r figures, results = "asis"}
i <- 0
for (block in params$blocks) {
  cat("\n\n## ", block$title, "\n\n", sep = "")
  for (f in block$figures) {
    i <- i + 1
    cat("\n\n### ", f$title, "\n\n", sep = "")
    png <- file.path(params$fig_dir, sprintf("figure_%03d.png", i))
    msg <- tryCatch({
      suppressMessages(suppressWarnings(
        ggplot2::ggsave(png, f$draw(), width = f$width, height = f$height, dpi = 110)))
      ""
    }, error = function(e) conditionMessage(e))
    if (nzchar(msg)) cat("*Could not draw this figure: ", gsub("\n", " ", msg), "*\n\n", sep = "")
    else cat("![](", png, "){width=100%}\n\n", sep = "")
  }
}
```
